timeline.event: Incorporated on 7 March 1988 as a JV of HPCL and Indian Rayon & Industries Ltd (A.V. Birla Group)
Phase-I refinery (3.69 MMTPA) commissioned; commercial operations begin (March 1996)
Phase-II completed (Sept 1999), capacity raised to 9.69 MMTPA
28 March 2003: ONGC acquires A.V. Birla Group stake and infuses Rs 600 crore; MRPL becomes ONGC subsidiary
ONGC Mangalore Petrochemicals Ltd (OMPL) incorporated (19 Dec 2006) to build aromatic complex in MSEZ
Granted Miniratna status by Government of India
Foundation stone for Phase-III refinery expansion-cum-upgradation (Nov 2009)
CDU/VDU-III commissioned 29 March 2012; Phase-III raises capacity to 15 MMTPA (from 11.82)
OMPL Aromatic Complex (PX ~0.9 MMTPA, benzene ~0.28 MMTPA) commissioned Oct 2014
Feb 2015: MRPL raises stake in OMPL from 3% to 46%
Polypropylene unit (440 KTPA, MANGPOL) starts commercial production June 2015 - last Phase-III unit
ONGC acquires HPCL; HPCL-MRPL merger mooted (board approvals/plans reported Aug 2018)
27 Feb 2018: COCO retail outlet inaugurated at Panambur, Mangaluru (early HiQ retail network)
BS-VI MS/HSD supply begins (geared from March 2020, ahead of 1 April 2020 national deadline)
1 Jan 2021: MRPL acquires ONGC's ~49% stake in OMPL (Rs 1,216.7 cr), taking holding to 99.9998%
OMPL amalgamated into MRPL: MCA order 14 Apr 2022, appointed date 1 Apr 2021, effective 1 May 2022
28 Feb 2024: Mundkur Shyamprasad Kamath becomes MD; 8 Aug 2024: Nandakumar V. Pillai becomes Director (Refinery)
25 Mar 2025: Devendra Kumar takes charge as Director (Finance) & CFO
FY2025-26: record 16.774 MMT crude (111.8% utilisation), 13 VLCCs handled, 85 new HiQ outlets (total 252), first outlet in Andhra Pradesh, Devangonthi terminal fully operational
Iso-Butyl Benzene (IBB) 200 TPA demo plant mechanically complete Dec 2025 (in-house patented process with CSIR-NCL)
28 Mar 2026: four Independent Directors complete tenure; Jun-Jul 2026 Dr Seema (Govt nominee) and Satyan Kumar (ONGC nominee) join board; 12 Aug 2026 new CVO
Projects in execution: Power System Upgradation (grid connectivity, Rs 385 cr, Sep 2026), demo Bio-ATF/SAF plant (Jan 2027), 500 TPA green hydrogen (Mar 2027)

departments.name: Operations (Production)
departments.description: Runs refinery process units across Phase-I/II/III blocks and aromatics; headed by GGM (Operations) under ED (Refinery). One of 16 listed departments; tender dept 'Operations Plant'.

departments.name: Operations - Phase III & Aromatics Complex
departments.description: Operation of Phase-III units (PFCC, DCU, PP etc.) and the ex-OMPL Aromatic Complex in MSEZ; headed by a CGM.

departments.name: Operations - Oil Movement & Storage (OM&S), Jetty
departments.description: Crude/product tankage, blending, dispatch, pipelines to NMPA jetties and SPM Mangala-1; tender dept 'Operations OM&S, Jetty / Environmental / Horticulture'.

departments.name: Polypropylene Unit (Petrochemicals)
departments.description: 440 KTPA Novolen gas-phase PP plant producing MANGPOL grades from PFCC propylene.

departments.name: Production Planning & Quality Control (PP & QC)
departments.description: Crude/product planning and QC laboratory (ISO/IEC 17025 accredited lab); CGM (PP & QC) and GM-Production Planning positions.

departments.name: Technical Services
departments.description: Process monitoring, optimisation, energy & yield improvement, design/engineering, documentation, inspection and laboratory support; headed by GGM (TS).

departments.name: Process Engineering
departments.description: Process design/troubleshooting and revamp studies; headed by CGM (Process Engineering).

departments.name: Engineering & Inspection
departments.description: Static equipment inspection, integrity/corrosion management and engineering; CGM and GM (Engineering & Inspection).

departments.name: Research & Development
departments.description: DSIR-recognised R&D: catalyst/technology development, AI/ML for process optimisation, polymer & bitumen products, IBB process; 18 patents filed till FY23.

departments.name: Maintenance
departments.description: Plant maintenance and reliability; headed by GGM (Maintenance) with multiple CGMs and ~10 GMs.

departments.name: Mechanical Maintenance
departments.description: Rotating/static equipment maintenance, turnarounds; appears as tendering department.

departments.name: Electrical Maintenance
departments.description: Electrical systems incl. captive power distribution and grid connectivity; CGM (Maintenance-Electrical).

departments.name: Instrumentation Maintenance
departments.description: DCS/field instrumentation and control systems; CGM (Maintenance-Instrumentation), tender dept 'Instrument Maintenance'.

departments.name: Civil Works
departments.description: Civil construction and upkeep of plant and township; tendering department 'Civil works'.

departments.name: Captive Power Plants & Utilities
departments.description: Captive Power Plant I & II, steam, cooling water; subject of AI/ML load optimisation and the Power System Upgradation project (220/33 kV grid link).

departments.name: Health, Safety & Environment
departments.description: Safety management, environment compliance (CFE/CFO/HW authorisations), EMS; headed by GGM (HSE).

departments.name: Fire & Safety
departments.description: Refinery fire service and safety; GM (Fire & Safety) position; fireman grades A/B/C in non-management cadre.

departments.name: Environment & Horticulture
departments.description: Environmental management, green belt development, water/effluent (WWTP/ETP); grouped with OM&S in tender departments.

departments.name: Occupational Health / Medical
departments.description: Three 24x7 Occupational Health Centres and a hospital headed by the Chief Medical Officer.

departments.name: Projects
departments.description: Concept-to-commissioning of capital projects (Bio-ATF, green H2, power upgradation, pipelines); ED (Projects), GGM & CGMs (Projects).

departments.name: Corporate Strategy
departments.description: Long-term strategy, business development, energy transition planning; headed by GGM (Corporate Strategy).

departments.name: Impex & Shipping (Crude Procurement, Chartering, International Trade Desk)
